kind: walk-forward validation of the ensemble weighting schemes (aggregated statistics)

nber_dates.regime_rule: origin labelled RECESSION when any month of its target period is an NBER recession month; final peak/trough chronology, retrospective, not USREC latest

method.walk_forward: every origin of the protocol windows W1 and W2, same origins as the harness
method.actual_values_source: first publication from the local dense ALFRED vintage archive, transformed locally to the protocol target definition (T1: 100*(CPI_t/CPI_t-12-1); T2: 400*ln(GDP_q/GDP_q-1))
method.significance: DM/GW HAC h-1 + HLN, one-sided candidate better; Romano-Wolf stepdown with the stationary bootstrap over the weighted schemes, FWER 0.10
method.relative_loss: candidate aggregate loss / ENSEMBLE_EQUAL aggregate loss in the same subset
method.regime_split: NBER peak/trough months of the target period (retrospective diagnostic)
method.aggregation: no per-origin values are stored: counts, aggregates and SHA-256 digests only

ensemble_validation: not an admission decision; no C1-C6 gate is applied

loss_conventions.CRPS: protocol CRPS = twice the mean pinball loss over the 19-quantile grid

limitations: walk-forward validation, not an admission decision: no C1-C6 gate is applied and no stage is advanced
REAL_TIME origins only are admissible for admission; PSEUDO_REAL_TIME origins that appear at the start of W1 are reported separately and must not be read as REAL_TIME evidence
the first-publication actuals come from the quarterly ALFRED vintage grid, so 'first publication' is the first archived release at or after the publication, a documented approximation
T2 h=0 is limited by the GDPC1 first-publication coverage: the early quarters of W1 may be skipped (the exact counts are in the report)
no SPF member enters the T1 ensemble (SPF has no monthly y/y CPI forecast); for T2 the SPF member enters only when its survey mapping is available at the origin
the NBER regime split is a retrospective diagnostic by the final chronology; it is not PIT and it is not used as a gate
C4/W1 on the historical windows remains limited by data availability (docs/76); this tool reports statistics and does not re-open that question
aggregates only: per-origin actuals, forecasts, losses and weights are not stored, only counts, aggregates and SHA-256 digests

target actuals are transformed locally from the first-publication vintage because amfe.evaluation.actuals.actual_pair returns the raw series level for T1/T2 (unit mismatch flagged to the Lead); the transformation is documented in first_publication_target()

T2 CRPS aggregates are invalid because of extreme ensemble quantile artifacts (see data_quality); they are excluded from the conclusions and the report must be regenerated after the mixture defect is fixed
the local ALFRED vintage grid is quarterly, so first-publication actuals are approximate (first archived release at/after publication)
reported relative losses are validation statistics only; no candidate is promoted to admission by this report
licence_note: third-party actual values and member forecasts are not stored; only derived statistics, counts and digests are published (docs/84)

data_quality.how: separate post-run scan over the same origins (not part of the automated aggregate builder)

T1_CPI_YOY/h1.note: quantiles bounded; losses in percentage points of CPI y/y

T2_GDP_GROWTH/h0.reason: ensemble mixture produces extreme upper quantiles at many origins: q95 up to ~18625 while the point forecast and actual are ~2-4 percentage points of annualised GDP growth
T2_GDP_GROWTH/h0.consequence: T2 CRPS aggregates (relative CRPS values and CRPS-based RW rejections) are invalid and must not be used; T2 RMSE aggregates are unaffected. The defect is in the stage-7 ensemble distribution mixture / member densities, not in this validation tool; the report must be regenerated after the mixture is fixed
